# Magscie

> Magscie is a leading refractory materials manufacturer specializing in magnesia chrome bricks, high alumina bricks, and mullite insulation products for steel, cement, and glass industries.

Based in Tianjin Binhai Hi-Tech Industrial Park, Magscie produces advanced refractory solutions with a focus on quality management, thermal performance, and slag resistance for high-temperature industrial applications.

## Key Topics

- Magnesia Chrome Brick (DMK, RMK, SRK)
- High Alumina Brick
- Mullite Insulation Brick
- Refractory Materials
- Steel Casting Applications
- Slag Resistance
- Thermal Insulation
- Basic Refractories
- Magnesia Dolomite Brick
- High Temperature Materials
- Product Specifications
- Alkaline Refractories
- MgO Content
- Ceramic Fiber Products
- Industrial Furnace Linings

## Core Products & Catalog

- [Refractory Brick](https://www.magscie.com/refractory-brick): Main refractory brick product catalog: magnesia chrome, high alumina, mullite
- [Basic Refractory Brick](https://www.magscie.com/refractory-brick/basic-brick): Basic refractory brick types: magnesia chrome, magnesia dolomite products
- [Aluminum Brick](https://www.magscie.com/refractory-brick/aluminum-brick): High alumina brick products: DRL, ANCHOR-HA for steel casting applications

## Magnesia Chrome Brick Products

- [Direct Bonded Magnesia Chrome Brick](https://www.magscie.com/blog/direct-bonded-magnesia-chrome-bricks-dmk): Direct Bonded Magnesia Chrome Brick (DMK) specifications and steel furnace applications
- [Rebonded Fused Magnesia Chrome Brick](https://www.magscie.com/blog/reboned-fused-magnesia-chrome-brick): Rebonded Fused Magnesia Chrome Brick (RMK) superior slag resistance properties
- [Semi-Rebonded Magnesia Chrome Brick](https://www.magscie.com/blog/semi-rebonded-magnesia-chrome-brick): Semi-Rebonded Magnesia Chrome Brick (SRK) composition and steelmaking applications
- [Magnesia Brick](https://www.magscie.com/blog/magnesia-brick): Magnesia Brick (MZ) for steel and nonferrous metal smelting furnace linings

## Specialized Refractory Materials

- [Magnesia Dolomite Brick](https://www.magscie.com/blog/magnesia-dolomite-brick): Magnesia Dolomite Brick uses in AOD furnaces, steel ladles, cement kilns
- [Magnesia Alumina Brick](https://www.magscie.com/blog/magnesia-alumina-brick): Magnesia Alumina Brick (MAL) for metal smelting furnace and glass regenerator
- [Magnesia Alumina Spinel Brick](https://www.magscie.com/blog/magnesia-alumina-spinel-brick): Magnesia Alumina Spinel Brick (MAS) thermal shock and high temperature resistance

## Steel Casting & Pouring Systems

- [Pouring Steel Brick](https://www.magscie.com/blog/pouring-steel-brick): Pouring steel brick specifications and molten steel handling applications
- [Stopper Head Brick](https://www.magscie.com/blog/stopper-head-brick): Stopper head brick and nozzle systems for molten metal control in steel casting
- [Center Brick for Bottom Pouring Set](https://www.magscie.com/blog/center-brick-for-bottom-pouring-set): Center brick and king brick for bottom pouring steel casting sets
- [Sleeve Brick](https://www.magscie.com/blog/sleeve-brick): Sleeve brick for stopper rod insulation in high temperature steel casting
